item.description: #UNGA81 🗓 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov held a meeting with Secretary-General of the League of Arab States Nabil Fahmy in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly. Sergey Lavrov congratulated Nabil Fahmy on his appointment as Secretary-General of this authoritative pan-Arab organisation and wished him success in this important role. 🤝 They discussed practical steps to further strengthen cooperation between Russia and the LAS. Particular attention was paid to reinvigorating existing mechanisms for bilateral cooperation, including the Russia-Arab Cooperation Forum . They also held an in-depth discussion of current Middle Eastern issues, focusing on the volatile situation in the Persian Gulf caused by the US-Israeli aggression against Iran . They also addressed the crises in the Palestinian-Israeli conflict zone , Lebanon and Syria . #RussiaLAS

❗
Statement by a Russian representative at the 63rd session of the UN Human Rights Council during the Interactive dialogue on Secretary-General report on cooperation with the United Nations:
📍
September 23, 2026, Geneva
👋
I greet you on behalf of the Human Rights Commissioner of the Russian Federation,
Yana Lantratova
. I have to speak from the placard "Russian Federation" rather than "National Human Rights Institution" (NHRI), a fact that
clearly illustrates the problems within the system of international NHRI recognition
, as the Russian institution was stripped of its "A" status accreditation. The grounds for this decision are
opaque
and raise
serious questions
.
🇷🇺
Russia is consistently developing
its own national model for human rights protection
, based on the Constitution, norms of international law, historical experience, and the spiritual and moral values ​​of the Russian people.
👤
At the heart of this model lies
human
–
his dignity, rights, and freedoms
. We view civil and political rights as inextricably linked to social, economic, and cultural rights. Human dignity
cannot be protected selectively
.
❗️
The international human rights agenda is frequently used as
a tool to promote double standards.
Such an approach undermines trust in international mechanisms and hinders equitable dialogue.
👉
The primary mission of our institution is
to restore the violated rights of the particular person
. Civil society, based on solidarity and responsibility, remains a key partner.
🤝
The Commissioner
is ready to develop cooperation
with the UN and foreign counterparts based on mutual respect and equal partnership. We advocate for a
joint search for solutions in the interests of the people
– free from politicization and pressure.
#HRC63

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and President of the UN General Assembly Khalilur Rahman
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇺🇳 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and President of the UN General Assembly Khalilur Rahman held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Sides discussed issues on the Session's agenda in detail. It was emphasised that the UN General Assembly remains the central and most representative forum for dialogue among states. In this context, they stressed the need to improve the atmosphere and restore mutually respectful dialogue within this body . Sergey Lavrov wished Khalilur Rahman success in his important international role. Russia's Foreign Minister expressed hope that the General Assembly’s work during the current Session would be conducted professionally and free from politicisation , with a view to collectively finding responses to global challenges and threats . #UNGA81

🎙
Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova's
statement
on the 30th anniversary of the opening for signature of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty
(September 24, 2026)
💬
September 24 marks the 30th anniversary of the opening for signature of
the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty
(
#CTBT
). This anniversary provides
an excellent opportunity to take stock of the situation surrounding the CTBT.
Despite the fact that the Treaty has been ratified by
179 of the 188 states
that had signed it,
the prospects for the CTBT entering into force remain just as uncertain
due to the position of a number of countries,
primarily the US
, which was one of the Treaty’s initiators, but has nevertheless failed over the decades to take effective steps towards ratifying it.
The US leadership’s claim that the draft law to that effect would not pass Congress
does not stand up to scrutiny.
Notably, Congress is quick to pass legislation that serves the vested interests of the US political establishment.
Things we’ve been hearing Washington say of late are of
particular concern
to us.
President Donald Trump’s October 29, 2025 directive
to begin preparations for nuclear testing is
not empty rhetoric
; it is effectively
a direct threat to the moratorium
that has helped prevent the world from sliding into a new round of the nuclear arms race.
☝️
The US attempts to accuse other countries of actions that are allegedly incompatible with the Treaty are completely unfounded
. Every time we hear Washington make such statements, we know that the Americans once again intend to walk away from their international commitments.
The Russian Federation was
the first of the five nuclear-weapon states
to join the CTBT and did so on the day it was opened for signature, September 24, 1996.
For over 20 years now, we’ve maintained this status even as Washington failed to make any progress whatsoever towards ratifying the Treaty.
However, this could not go on indefinitely.
In 2023,
Russia withdrew its ratification
, thus restoring parity with the US
in terms of international legal commitments in this area.
Russia remains a party to the CTBT
, with all the rights and obligations arising from that status.
We continue to work responsibly in
the Preparatory Commission for the CTBTO
. In December 2023, we
completed the construction
of the national segment of
the International Monitoring System
, the world’s second-largest:
32 facilities have been certified and are operational
.
❗️
The Russian Federation continues to observe the voluntary moratorium on nuclear testing introduced by the Soviet Union back in 1990
.
💬
On November 5, 2025,
President Vladimir Putin
stated expressly
:
“Russia has always strictly complied with and continues to comply with its obligations under the CTBT, and we have no plans to depart from them.
However, if the US or other states parties to the treaty conduct full-scale nuclear tests, Russia will have to respond in kind”.
We continue to consistently follow this approach.

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates of Syria Asaad Al-Shaibani
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇸🇾 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates of Syria Asaad Al-Shaibani held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . 👉 Sergey Lavrov's opening remarks The Ministers discussed in detail the development of Russia-Syria relations , including maintaining regular political dialogue and expanding mutually beneficial practical cooperation across various fields. The Russian Side reaffirmed its principled support for Syria’s unity, sovereignty and territorial integrity . It stressed the need to coordinate international efforts to advance Syria’s post-conflict recovery and assist its leadership in overcoming the challenges of the transition period. The Ministers also discussed current regional issues of mutual interest , focusing on unresolved crises along Syria’s borders. The Sides agreed to maintain contacts at various levels, including in multilateral forums. #RussiaSyria

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Brazil
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇧🇷 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Brazil Mauro Vieira held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly. In a traditionally constructive atmosphere of trust, the Ministers held an in-depth discussion to coordinate positions on key international issues , including in light of the outcomes of the #BRICS Summit held in New Delhi on September 12-13. They had a thorough discussion the current state and prospects of bilateral cooperation , including the schedule of planned contacts. Mauro Vieira outlined preparations for Brazil’s upcoming general elections. The Ministers stressed the imperative of ensuring the free expression of the people’s will without external interference in internal affairs . 🤝 They also noted that Russia and Brazil, both countries with centuries-old historical traditions, share a commitment to treating history with care and rejecting arbitrary interpretations of it . #RussiaBrazil

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Cuba Bruno Rodriguez
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇨🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Cuba Bruno Rodriguez held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . In their traditionally open and trusting manner, the Ministers held a constructive exchange of views on current issues of bilateral cooperation , discussed selected regional matters and a greed to further coordinate their positions in international forums , above all at the UN. Sergey Lavrov reaffirmed Russia’s unwavering support for Havana’s just demand for an immediate and complete end to the US trade, economic, financial and, more recently, energy blockade . He stressed the need to remove Cuba , a friend of Russia, from the notorious US list of so-called state sponsors of terrorism and condemned the extraterritorial nature of the unilateral restrictive measures imposed on the Island of Freedom. The Ministers reaffirmed their commitment to continued dialogue and cooperation to strengthen the Russia-Cuba strategic partnership , promote global and regional security, and build a more just #MultipolarWorld order based on respect for the sovereignty of states and their right to choose their own development paths. #RussiaCuba
